title: QL-1.03 Security checklist before merge on every change that touches command execution, auth, tokens, the tunnel or the oplog
request: Closes quality-loop principle 7. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none. Quality-loop principle set of 30 October 2026 (owner's order: implement as a gate for all dev).

tasks.title: Sensitive-path gate
requirements: scripts/gate/sensitive-paths.json lists the sensitive globs by area: command execution (src/engine/contracts.mjs, src/cli/runner.mjs, src/cli/setup-remote.mjs, src/engine/setup-channel.mjs, src/cli/contracts-cli.mjs), auth and tokens (src/server/oauth.mjs, src/engine/tokens.mjs, src/engine/devices.mjs, src/engine/sshsig.mjs when it exists), the tunnel and relay (src/cli/tunnel.mjs, src/engine/relay*.mjs, src/server/http.mjs), the oplog (src/engine/oplog.mjs, src/engine/vault.mjs)

scripts/gate/sensitive-paths.mjs --base <sha> lists the changed files that match; when any does, it requires security/checklists/<head-sha-12>.md (or the file named by --checklist) with the four headings Who can call this, What runs, What survives a restart, What happens with two processes, each followed by at least one non-empty line that names a file:line, and a line Head: <40-hex> equal to the head being checked
exit 1 with the missing answers named; exit 0 when no sensitive file changed or the checklist is complete; the script has no dependencies and carries a version: comment

criteria.statement: A diff touching oplog.mjs without a checklist fails, with a checklist missing one answer fails naming it, with a complete checklist for the same head passes, and a docs-only diff passes without one
The checklist folder explains the four questions

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

tasks.title: Wired into CI and the push hook
requirements: the CI workflow runs the gate against the pull request's base on every pull request and on push to main
memev contract hook installs a pre-push hook that runs the gate beside memev gate
docs/DEVELOPING.md names the sensitive areas and the four questions

criteria.statement: The workflow file runs scripts/gate/sensitive-paths.mjs on pull requests and the installed pre-push hook calls it
The developing page lists the four questions
